new_components: G9 synthetic model validation and G10 observation-model validation gates
scientific_assumptions: transition rows are already aggregated to one patient x transition
Gaussian residuals are a first interpretable model assumption, not a biological truth
spatial neighbourhood summaries are descriptive and non-causal
uncertainty_score is a heuristic quality score, not a calibrated confidence interval
selection and plasticity require clone identity, temporal overlap, abundance and QC evidence
known_limitations: no clone-resolved human longitudinal dataset currently passes all criteria
spatial confounding is represented but not causally identified
observation model is an interface only
full real-cohort probabilistic transition fitting is NOT_IMPLEMENTED pending compatible patient-level transition tables
